name: Sofia Ramirez Garcia
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport was a happy accident. After years managing restaurants in Barcelona, a friend involved in a local racing team asked for help with their catering. What started as a favor quickly turned into a passion. She discovered a unique satisfaction in fueling the high-performance environment of the track.

Now at Anderson Racing, Sofia brings a meticulous approach to her role. She focuses on providing nutritious and appealing meals that cater to the diverse dietary needs of the team, from the mechanics needing high-energy options to the drivers requiring light, easily digestible food. What sets Sofia apart is her ability to create a sense of community through food, fostering camaraderie and boosting morale in the intense atmosphere of the paddock. She's known for her paella nights during testing sessions, a tradition that even rival teams secretly envy.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical bun with a few loose strands framing her face.
physical.description: Sofia is a woman of average height with a warm, welcoming smile and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Insists on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, even when traveling.
Has a habit of humming traditional Spanish songs while prepping meals, a habit that amuses and sometimes annoys her colleagues.
